summary: The implementation fully satisfies REQ-9 by modifying App.tsx to check authentication status first and render LoginScreen for unauthenticated users. The LoginScreen component provides a prominent, visually appealing login interface with Internet Identity integration. All acceptance criteria are met: login is shown first, the interface is prominent and guides users to authenticate, authenticated users proceed to main content, and unauthenticated users cannot access main features.

hallucinated_features.description: Loading state with spinner during authentication initialization
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify handling of loading/initialization states. While this is good UX practice, it was not explicitly requested in REQ-9 or acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Branded login screen with features grid showcasing platform capabilities (Ask Doubts, Share Knowledge, Earn Recognition)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires presenting the login option, not creating a marketing/onboarding experience with feature highlights. The acceptance criteria specify 'prominently displayed' and 'clearly guides users' but do not request feature showcases or hero sections.
